row.name: Sith Trooper Gear
row.description: Your issued combat armor plus a Blaster Rifle, granted free at character creation. Mirrors the Republic trooper's issued kit (Republic Issued Gear, 20-point tier) in application. The armor is currently a Combat Suit (Medium, Durasteel, full coverage: the 3,580 CR suit in Chapter 13), standing in for a dedicated Sith trooper armor until one is designed.
